_about: Hand-checked facts about NPCs that QuestieDB's WoW Forever data has wrong. tools/objectives/gen.py and tools/routes/gen.py apply them to the data before anything else. 'faction' replaces the NPC's friendlyToFaction (A, H or AH): a giver marked as one faction's makes all their quests that faction's only. Every entry names where it was checked (src). Add only what a source or an in-game check confirms.

<NPC ID>.name: NPC name, to read the file by

256222.name: Ketharas
src: in-game check, 2026-11-28: a Horde character (Orc) took Violence Into Verdure and The Bounty of Nature from him at Mount Hyjal 73.3,81.9 and was working on both (QuestieDB marks him A, which left all his quests out for the Horde)

228216.name: Nami
src: Premiere Parts (92008) says 'Retrieve Kaylaena Springbolt's parts order from Nami in Everlook'; QuestieDB's Mount Hyjal spawn (60.1,61.18) is Kaylaena Springwhisper's exact spot, copied. In-game check 2026-11-28: Nami stands in Everlook, Winterspring 61.3,37.0 with the Premiere Parts hand-in
